The Kuldra raid is out alongside the RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 launch. This guide provides helpful tips, tricks and skips to help you with your first or fiftieth clear.
I'm CrossRSDW, and I spent time stress-testing the raid so you don't have to. I've found cheese, tricks, and skips that will speed up your farming runs.
